## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, the change, and any linked GitHub Issue.

## Validation

List commands and results. Include Playwright evidence for frontend changes.
Explain any compatibility impact and whether a version bump is included.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read PRD.md, CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, and AGENTS.md.
- [ ] The change is focused and artifacts are in English.
- [ ] Tests and gates pass without weakening or skipping verification.
- [ ] No credentials, machine state, or generated caches are included.
